It also provides conservative skill routing, lifecycle hooks, bounded memory, compaction checkpoints, and measurement tools. Explicit full, raw, benchmark, and verbatim requests pass through literally; provider billing and universal-savings claims remain outside local measurements.

Use bounded projections with expandable proof for exact recovery; route specialist docs, browser, media, or app work separately.
